bounds_note: 0.01 rad/s is the R3 native settle limit; finite-difference discrepancy uses that same pre-registered threshold and is not a calibrated error estimate. Finger tolerance inherited from R1 free-acceleration numerical scale only as a diagnostic, not source certification.
